title: Event record
description: One adverse event of one patient in one scenario. The engine records events that reach grade 3 to 5 in usual care, and interstitial lung disease of any grade. With monitoring such an event can be recognised at a lower grade.

scenario_id.title: Scenario
scenario_id.description: Identifier of the intervention scenario, as in the scenario table.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: CTCAE grade at which the event was recognised and treated. Grade 5 is death from the event.

onset_day.title: Day of onset
onset_day.description: Day on which the event actually started.

day.title: Day of recognition
day.description: Day on which the event was recognised by the care team.

detected_by.title: Recognised through
detected_by.description: routine: at a regular visit or because the patient sought help. monitoring: after an alert of a monitoring component.

usual_care_day.title: Day of recognition in usual care
usual_care_day.description: Day on which the event would have been recognised without monitoring.

usual_care_grade.title: Grade in usual care
usual_care_grade.description: Grade that the event would have reached without monitoring.

action.title: Action
action.description: Change of the therapy in response to the event.

hospital_days.title: Hospital days
hospital_days.description: Days in hospital because of the event, including intensive care.

icu_days.title: Intensive care days
icu_days.description: Days in intensive care because of the event.

unplanned_visit.title: Unplanned visit
unplanned_visit.description: The event led to an unplanned outpatient visit.
